$comment: Architecture budgets for the 2026-11-07 SOLID remediation program. Measured by scripts/architecture-budget.mjs. `max` is the ceiling enforced by `npm run architecture:check`; `target` is the program-end value each workstream drives the metric to. Audit numbers come from research/docs/2026-11-07-solid-principles-audit.md / the HTML report; deviations are recorded in docs/solid-remediation-decisions.md.

baseline.audit: 2026-11-07 SOLID audit (measured on 20bc219; tree advanced by 5a31bf7 before execution)

largestSourceFileLines.note: dashboard/src/pages/Analysis.tsx. WS6 target: no page file over 500 lines.

largestPageFileLines.note: WS6 target: < 500 lines per page file.

largestBackendModuleLines.note: packages/persistence/src/harness/repository.ts measured 272 at 5a31bf7 (audit 264 at 20bc219). Ceiling matches the WS3c target of < 300 lines per backend module.

pageFilesDefiningDataHooks.note: Page entry files over 1000 lines that own data access (Analysis, Oversight, Experiments, Runs). WS5/WS6 drive to 0.

fetchPageImplementations.note: 2 fetch hooks + 4 pagers at baseline (dashboard/src/lib + Oversight.tsx). WS5 target: one implementation (useResource*/query.ts).

providerSettingsPolicySites.note: Audit 9 sites / 7 backend files; the dashboard copy in Experiments.tsx makes 10. WS4 collapses the backend copies to packages/domain/src/providers/settings.ts; the dashboard copy goes in WS6.

providerNameBranchSites.note: Broader regex than the audit (includes dashboard and worker branches). WS4 removes provider-name branches outside the registry; dashboard sites are WS6.

scenarioVersionLiteralSites.note: 30 sites / 14 files reproduces the audit exactly (import/export wiring excluded). WS4 brings the backend to ~3 sites; dashboard remainder is WS6.

statusVocabularyArraySites.note: Superset of the audit's narrower 'terminal RunStatus subsets' census (4 files / 8 sites): counts every status array with >= 2 run statuses. WS7 T7.3 drives it into dispatch/constant tables.

AnalysisRepository.note: WS2 T2.2 splits it into CodebookStore/JobLifecycleStore/WindowStore/ArtifactStore/ResultStore; no capability port may exceed 8 members.

ResearcherRepository.note: 13 declared members plus the 7 inherited from Repository = the audit's 20. WS2 keeps it only as a composed type for the API composition root; consumers narrow to capability ports.

Repository.note: Harness Repository. WS2 T2.3 splits it into RunStateStore/EventLog/RunQueue/WorkerGuard; it may remain as a composed alias, so the ceiling is the baseline.
